title: Coding model guarded load and speed check
scope: Take over from the private Windows handover: independently re-verify the downloaded coding weights, then load them once on the existing portable runtime with partial GPU offload and memory guards and record load feasibility, memory and speed on a generic non-CPIN coding prompt. No CPIN inference, downloads, network service, paid calls, publication or code changes; private receipts stay outside GitHub.
